configurable_props.name: board
configurable_props.label: Board
configurable_props.description: The Trello board you wish to select

configurable_props.name: pos
configurable_props.label: Position
configurable_props.description: The position of the new card. `top`, `bottom`, or a positive float

configurable_props.name: due
configurable_props.label: Due Date
configurable_props.description: Card due date in ISO format

configurable_props.name: idList
configurable_props.label: List
configurable_props.description: The ID of the list the card should be created in.

configurable_props.name: idMembers
configurable_props.label: Members
configurable_props.description: Array of member IDs to add to the card

configurable_props.name: idLabels
configurable_props.label: Labels
configurable_props.description: Array of labelIDs to add to the card

configurable_props.name: file
configurable_props.label: File Path or URL
configurable_props.description: Provide either a file URL or a path to a file in the /tmp directory (for example, /tmp/myFile.pdf).

configurable_props.name: mimeType
configurable_props.label: Mime Type
configurable_props.description: Mime type of the attached file. Eg. `application/pdf`

configurable_props.name: idCardSource
configurable_props.label: Copy Card
configurable_props.description: Specify an existing card to copy contents from. Keep in mind that if you copy a card, the **File Attachment Path**, **File Attachment URL** and **File Attachment Type** fields will be ignored.

configurable_props.name: keepFromSource
configurable_props.label: Copy From Source
configurable_props.description: Specify which properties to copy from the source card

configurable_props.name: address
configurable_props.label: Address
configurable_props.description: For use with/by the Map Power-Up

configurable_props.name: locationName
configurable_props.label: Location Name
configurable_props.description: For use with/by the Map Power-Up

configurable_props.name: coordinates
configurable_props.label: Coordinates
configurable_props.description: Latitude, longitude coordinates. For use with/by the Map Power-Up. Should take the form `lat, long`.

configurable_props.name: customFieldIds
configurable_props.label: Custom Field Ids
configurable_props.description: An array of custom field Ids to create/update
